div.div: فَهِدٌ and فِهِدْ [A man] resembling the فَهْد [or lynx] in his stretching himself and has sleeping [or in his doing thus much, or often]: and [a man] being. or feigning himself, heedless of what is requisite, or necessary to be done. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
